autonomy_hardening_20261103.instruction: owner, 2026-11-03: 'Ok let's fix it so it's fully autonomous'

defects_fixed.no_outcome_memory: state/continuous_loop_state.json is reset as tasks are retried, so the two tasks this lane has never once passed were re-dispatched every campaign (1 completed of 10 over the last six campaigns). Now state/task_history.json holds a durable record keyed by a hash of the task SPEC: 3 attempts with 0 passes -> blocked 'never_solved ... needs_author'; a changed brief/acceptance/lane reopens the door; one pass clears it; --resume clears it. select_task retries 'failed' tasks and lets the memory decide when retrying is pointless.
defects_fixed.silent_lane_substitution: campaign 20261103T191733Z refused dispatch with profile_mismatch lane=qwen3-embedding:0.6b task=qwen3.5:4b after the first task loaded the model and free RAM dipped. resolve_lane fell back to the smallest model that fit - an embedding model that cannot run a tool call. Now: embed-only models are never candidates; a model Ollama already holds is resident and needs no extra RAM; a requested lane that is missing or does not fit is a refusal with a reason, never a substitution.
defects_fixed.no_work_supply: --status shows remaining=0 blocked=2: the queue is drained. New --backlog reads a pytest short summary and emits one PROPOSED task per failing node id (objective + acceptance = that test). Measured on the real 15-failure report: 15 proposals, 0 authorized, each validate_task() reporting the two things an author must supply (explicit authorization + write_paths).

autonomy_hardening_20261103.why_not_auto_dispatched: a node id is not a write scope; guessing the owning source file from a traceback is how an autonomous loop edits the wrong file or the test that grades it. Turning this step autonomous needs an evaluator, not more steps: candidate patches scored against the failing test + the regression suite + agent_kernel/content.py + a steward/reviewer verdict from a separate session, with best-of-N selection.

capacity_envelope_measured.conclusion: on 16 GB the image lane and the code lane cannot be resident together. FLUX 3 stays armed via MEDIA_GEN_LIVE=1 and starts on demand through scripts/start-flux3.ps1 (~1-2 min; the gateway answers 503 until then). A campaign needs the inverse: release the image lane and the resident model first - a scheduler task.
capacity_envelope_measured.note: qwen3.5:4b runs 100% CPU in Ollama (3.2 GB RAM, ctx 8192), which is why a Ty step costs minutes and why the 27B llama.cpp lane is the escalation target
